name: 宵崎奏
description: A quiet chibi digital pet inspired by a pale long-haired composer in an oversized navy jacket.
description_zh: 一只安静的 Q 版桌宠，灵感来自浅色长发、穿着宽大深蓝外套的作曲少女。
author: xiwanzi

name: 时崎狂三
description: A tiny clockwork gothic twin-tailed pet inspired by Kurumi Tokisaki, with red-black frills, ribbons, a clock eye, and a small pocket watch.
description_zh: 一只 Q 版时钟哥特桌宠，灵感来自时崎狂三的黑红荷叶边、双马尾、红色缎带、时钟眼和小怀表。
author: xiwanzi

name: Remi
description: A cute chibi vampire pet inspired by Remilia Scarlet, with red eyes, pale blue-purple hair, pink frills, red bows, and tiny bat wings.
description_zh: 一只可爱的 Q 版吸血鬼桌宠，灵感来自蕾米莉亚的红眼、浅蓝紫短发、粉色荷叶边、红色蝴蝶结和小蝙蝠翼。
author: xiwanzi
